clues.text: Samson fell in love with this woman, who lived in the Valley of Sorek.
The Philistine lords each promised her eleven hundred shekels of silver to learn the secret of Samson's strength.
She tied Samson with seven fresh bowstrings, but he snapped them like yarn seared by a flame.
While Samson slept, she wove the seven braids of his hair into a loom and tightened it with a pin.
She asked Samson how he could say he loved her when his heart was not with her.
She pressed Samson daily with her words until, sick to death, he revealed he was a Nazirite.
She lulled Samson to sleep on her lap, then called a man to shave his head.
